subject.title: fix(security): add estimate-before-decode guard to base64 paths

question: Should `validateBase64SizeLimit` become a supported public `@openclaw/media-core/base64-size-limit` package API, or should this PR keep the helper private?
rationale: Adding an exported package subpath is an API and compatibility decision; the narrow security fix does not require that public contract.

options.title: Keep the helper private
options.body: Use the existing base64 estimate in the CLI-owned implementation and remove the new package export, build entry, aliases, and barrel export.

options.title: Approve the package API
options.body: Retain the new subpath only with explicit ownership, intended consumers, and compatibility expectations for the exported validation behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep the helper private
recommendation.body: Use the existing base64 estimate in the CLI-owned implementation and remove the new package export, build entry, aliases, and barrel export.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person to the adjacent CLI execution boundary, though direct package ownership evidence is limited.
